difficulty_reason: The author core verifies many minimum cuts simultaneously and organizes Gomory–Hu-style star expansions by a recursive centroid decomposition. The difficult new obligation is bounding the total auxiliary graphs and certificates near-linearly, achieved by a cut-equivalent-tree path-length/capacity identity and the complete same-depth edge-accounting argument. This global certificate-size and construction-time analysis goes beyond the ordinary exercise of verifying one guessed flow and cut.
